verified_scope: The ICU abstract reports 625 of 7,525 patients with hallucinations and 69.1% visual-only classification. It shares the clinical cohort with PMID39891214.
FICUS names a nurse-led family support intervention in critical care. Outcomes include family satisfaction and communication instead of plant exposure.
FICUS names a study of staff experiences implementing family support. The research question concerns critical-care delivery.
The prospective report follows surgery in people with pre-existing neurological conditions, including a Parkinson subgroup. It tracks perioperative conditions and medications.
The Charles Bonnet report describes nightly visual episodes after retinal surgery and substantial vision loss.

A case with greatly reduced intake and multiple verified nutritional deficiencies after sleeve gastrectomy reports encephalopathy and visual hallucinations. The report provides no ingredient-specific exposure finding.
A separate hospitalization case describes audiovisual symptoms after changes in baclofen use.
A Parkinson patient with recent falls and medication changes developed acute vision loss attributed to arteritis. Visual loss is distinct from hallucination recurrence.
A qualitative Parkinson and caregiver interview study concerns emotional adjustment and family support.
